desc: The one reset cue (ResetCue, scripts/match/reset_cue.gd): whenever a condition hands an ability back (a takedown, an empowered hit, a knock), the hunter who got it sees a short bright flash on that HUD slot (ResetPop), a small glint on their body and hears the reset sound (the Settings variant). A teammate's reset shows only the glint, silent and no HUD; a rival's shows nothing. 'paths' lists every reset in the game by id and the HUD slots it flashes (dash = Shift, sec = RMB, k1 = E, x = R). A path missing here is an error in --kill-reset-check. Times in seconds, sizes in metres.
